acceptance: The 3.6.0 timestamp/hang behavior is confirmed fixed or reproduced against a loadable 4.x engine

context:
During the chdb-4x tuning follow-up (merged as PR #2719), the 4.x engine could not be loaded locally (dyld mis-aligned LINKEDIT; long venv paths truncated the diagnosis), so whether 4.x resolves the 3.6.0 timestamp/hang reports was never directly verified. The merge-time conclusion rests on inference, not on loading the engine.

2026-11-07: the locked chDB 4.1.6 wheel still does not load on macOS arm64 (seen during #4012). Arrow parity ran on 3.7.2 instead; see chdb-rows-nan-vs-arrow-null-q17-20261107.
description: Load a 4.x chDB engine in an environment where it runs (CI Linux or a clean venv with short paths) and directly verify the 3.6.0 timestamp/hang behavior. Record the outcome; if it reproduces, file a defect with the reproduction.
